sections.exact_prompt: All six rendered prompts printed in full and read before any model call: GPQA-Diamond 359 chars with seeded-shuffled options, AIME-2025 117, BBH 51, IFEval 304 passed through unmodified, TruthfulQA 80, GAIA 326. One instruction per prompt, appearing once.
sections.diff_or_audit: No proven in-repo builder exists for these six, so the design-principle branch: instruction-appears-once verified by reading; IFEval deliberately unmodified because obeying its prompt IS the measurement; GPQA options shuffled per item with a seeded RNG because the CSV stores the answer in a fixed column and file order would place gold at A every time; meaning spot-check on three golds (GPQA C = 10^-4 eV the largest gap, AIME 70 = 21+49, BBH not(True) and (True) = False). Three deviations recorded: BBH run zero-shot vs the canonical 3-shot CoT, IFEval's official verifier not implemented so it is asked but not scored, GAIA text-only so attachment questions cannot be answered. FOURTH DEVIATION: the step-by-step instruction is appended to five benchmarks but NOT IFEval — its prompts carry their own constraints (no commas, 300+ words, N highlighted sections) and a reasoning instruction would add a CONFLICTING instruction to the very thing being measured.
sections.parser_proof: Chosen against real CoT completions at 4096 from this model, which reasons then puts the answer on the LAST LINE — so a last-line parser is right and a first-token parser would read the opening of the reasoning (the 2026-07-07 defect). Proven: BBH 'False' (gold False), AIME '70' (gold 70), GPQA 'C' (gold C). GAIA exposed a requirement: on open-ended items the model PREFIXES the last line with 'Final Answer:' despite being told to answer by itself, so the parser strips a leading 'Final Answer:'/'Answer:' before matching; without it every open-ended item would fail to parse and be miscounted as a model failure. Substring containment REJECTED for exact-match: gold 'False' would match 'false' anywhere in a trace. TruthfulQA not scored — truthfulness needs a real judge and a wiring smoke must not fake one. RE-PROVEN on the local models: llama-3.1 returns 'D) 10^-8 eV' as its last line, not a bare letter, so the mcq parser takes the last standalone [ABCD] which resolves it to D. llama-2 returns 'B) 10^-11 eV' likewise. Both models emit the option TEXT alongside the letter despite being told to answer 'by itself, with no extra words' — the same non-compliance the MLX probe showed with its 'Final Answer:' prefix, so the parser must not assume the instruction is obeyed.
sections.detectability_plan: Ground truth spans outcomes: GPQA gold uniform over ABCD by the seeded shuffle, BBH and AIME exact targets, GAIA Final answer. Chance rates stated (GPQA 25%, AIME ~0.1%). Explicitly NOT a capability measurement at n=10 per benchmark: any accuracy is an OBSERVATION, never a rate. Sampling is seeded random, never a prefix, because all six files are ordered by domain/task/index/level.
sections.saturation_read: At n=10 saturation is a wiring signal not a competence signal: identical replies across items, or every GPQA answer the same letter, halts as BROKEN. The seeded GPQA option shuffle is what makes a constant-letter answerer detectable at all.
sections.generation_budget: RE-SET after a 1,000-CHARACTER PROMPT CAP (owner 2026-08-05). Worst prompt is now 998 chars, and a token is at least one character, so it can NEVER exceed 998 tokens whatever the tokenizer does. llama-2-13b-chat-gptq8: context 4,096 TOTAL; 998+2,900=3,898 < 4,096 fits by construction, so max_tokens=2900 (was 2048). Measured truncation at 2048 on the uncapped sample was 3/280 = 1.1%. llama-3.1-8b-instruct: context 32,768; measured 49/280 = 17.5% truncation at 4096, concentrated in AIME (67%) and GPQA (28%). Probed at 8192 and it STILL truncated with a visible repetition loop, so budget alone cannot fix it. Set to max_tokens=16000 — 4x the prior cap and ~10x the 1,610-char median completion — leaving true non-terminators as the only residual. A 12-item probe at 30,000 was ABANDONED after 13 minutes with no result (loopers burn the full cap); the 275-item run measures the same distribution better. Truncation is labelled TRUNCATED, never scored as wrong. The prompt cap fixes llama-2's HTTP 400 (an INPUT-size problem); it cannot fix llama-3.1's truncation (an OUTPUT-length problem) on AIME, whose prompts were already short.
sections.format_pressure_control: NOT run, and disclosed as a gap. This session's medical-logic work measured that a terse-answer instruction can suppress computation with ZERO truncation signature (0.812 vs 1.000 on identical items). The owner chose the reasoning-permitted form directly, so no terse arm exists here and format effects cannot be separated from capability.

claim: Prompts, parsers and PER-MODEL generation budgets for the llama-2/llama-3 behaviour-capture run are designed and evidenced against real output from both models on the local gateway. llama-2 is locked at 2048 (hard 4k context), llama-3.1 at 4096 (truncation on AIME is degenerate looping that doubling does not fix). 280 questions sampled by seeded random draw across six benchmarks.
scope: The wiring smoke only: 10 seeded-random questions per benchmark through MLX qwen36-35b-6bit, to confirm each dataset loads, renders a prompt, gets an answer, and parses. NOT in scope: any capability claim about the model, any published-comparable benchmark score, the crowd-wisdom experimental design, and the IFEval official verifier.

contradictions_found: My own draft smoke set max_tokens=512. The probe showed 512 TRUNCATES both AIME (1,222 chars) and GPQA (1,603 chars) mid-reasoning, so the draft would have scored reasoning-in-progress as wrong answers on the two hardest benchmarks. Corrected to 2048 before any run.

My draft used substring containment for the exact-match kind. With BBH gold 'False', any reasoning trace containing the word 'false' would score correct regardless of its conclusion — a checker that cannot fail. Replaced with last-non-empty-line matching.

My draft rendered GPQA options in CSV column order, which places the correct answer at A for every item. Any position-biased model would score near 100%. Replaced with a per-item seeded shuffle and gold recomputed from the shuffled position.

The model was told to give the final answer 'by itself, with no extra words' and returned 'Final Answer: Open' on GAIA anyway — the instruction is not reliably obeyed on open-ended items, so the parser strips the prefix rather than trusting compliance.
GAIA used ~3,214 of 4,096 tokens (78%), inside the 20% band where prompt-design 5c says escalate. Kept at 4096 per owner instruction; risk recorded.
mlx_client's documented default timeout of 60s is too short for a 4k reasoning generation on a 35B (GAIA probe: 93.7s). Raised to 900s — a tool-contract fact worth carrying back to TOOL.md.
I stamped this artifact 12:55 while the clock read 12:43; the completeness gate rejected it as future-dated. Corrected to the real clock.
llama-2-13b-chat-gptq8 has a 4,096-token TOTAL context. My first probe passed max_tokens=4096, leaving no room for the prompt, and every call returned HTTP 400. Budgets must be per-model, not global.

llama-3.1-8b-instruct truncates on AIME at BOTH 4096 and 8192, and the 8192 output is a repetition loop rather than longer reasoning. Per prompt-design 5c the escalation rule stops here and the condition is reported as budget-capped truncation on those items, not as wrong answers.

chars/4 token estimate FALSIFIED: gpqa-127 (5,792 chars) was predicted to fit at ~1,448 tokens and was rejected with HTTP 400. Cause visible in the item: 85% of it is four raw DNA sequences (~1,185 chars each) which BPE shatters into 1-3 char tokens. The heuristic is calibrated on English prose. Token counts must come from a tokenizer or the server's rejection; the capture now keeps the full error body.
prior_findings_reconciled: The 2026-07-07 medical-logic defect (a first-token parser mislabelling verbose/CoT output) — reconciled by choosing a LAST-value parser after observing that this model reasons then emits the bare answer last

The 0/16-cell defect (a truncated reply scored as accuracy 0.000 when the replies were merely unfinished) — reconciled by the budget probe and by labelling finish_reason=length as TRUNCATED rather than wrong

Defect D21 (a head(n) prefix slice of label-ordered data producing an all-negative eval that looked 98% accurate) — reconciled by seeded random sampling, and it applies directly: all six files are ordered by domain/task/index/level

This session's own smoke defect in the medical-logic project, where [:n] per operator drew ten TT rows so every correct answer was 'yes' — the same prefix mistake, which is why the sampling rule is stated explicitly here
none_found_after_search for prior crowd-wisdom findings — the project was created today and has no prior plan, log or artifacts
unknowns: Whether 2048 tokens suffices for the hardest AIME and GPQA items, or only for the three probed. The probe covered easy/hard/long but not a worst case, and the escalation rule stays available.
What IFEval accuracy would be, since its verifier is not implemented — the smoke can only confirm the prompt is sent and a reply returns.
How much of GAIA is answerable without attachments; the smoke will show it but the draw is 10 items and some may not reference files at all.
Whether the MLX gateway's 35B model degrades under memory pressure — TOOL.md flags this as an untrialed claim and I did not read the explore doc.
Whether zero-shot BBH numbers bear any relation to the 3-shot CoT protocol the benchmark was built for. Assumed NOT comparable, and recorded as such.
why_complete_enough: All six sections the judge gate requires are filled with evidence gathered before any scored run: prompts were dumped and read rather than assumed correct, parsers were chosen against real completions from the actual model rather than against expectations, and the budget was measured at three settings rather than defaulted. The three defects this process caught in my own draft (512-token truncation, substring matching, unshuffled GPQA options) are each recorded with the reason they would have produced wrong numbers. The residual risks are disclosed above and none of them affect whether the wiring works, which is all this smoke claims.
decision: Run 280 seeded-random questions (50 per benchmark; AIME caps at its full 30) through llama-2-13b-chat-gptq8 at max_tokens=2048 and llama-3.1-8b-instruct at max_tokens=4096, capturing the FULL reasoning trace for every item. Score only where a checkable gold exists; label truncation as TRUNCATED and never as wrong. Record the per-model budget difference as a condition difference, since llama-2's 4k context makes it a physical constraint rather than a free choice.
